resources.string:
The game needs 3 or more players (Up to 8).

The player who holds the phone is given a word and commits to imitating a sound that describes that word using only their voice. Everyone else shouts words until someone guesses the word. The first one to guess and the player whose turn it was get points. When the round is over the phone goes to the next person.

In each turn, the player holding the phone gets to pick the difficulty of their word. There are 3 difficulties, easy, normal, hard and they give 1, 2 and 3 points accordingly.

In case 2 or more people say the correct word at the same time, they both get points.

You can't use sounds that are words like "beep", "meow", "woof" etc. You have to imitate the sound.
